subject.title: feat: unify Claude Code / Codex session catalogs into native session UX

question: Should session catalogs become a permanent public Plugin SDK/Gateway contract, with operator catalog visibility independent of `supervision.enabled`?
rationale: This PR creates an external plugin API and changes an existing configuration contract; implementation review cannot safely select that long-term product and compatibility boundary.

options.title: Approve generic catalog contract
options.body: Adopt the new SDK/Gateway seam and tools-only supervision gate after all lifecycle, client-generation, UX, upgrade, and proof blockers are resolved.

options.title: Keep current plugin contracts
options.body: Retain the current shipped per-plugin catalog and supervision semantics and substantially narrow or close this rewrite.
